dedupe_keys.name: annual survey on rail transportation tables statistics canada

description: The Annual Survey on Rail Transportation of Statistics Canada collects annual financial, operating and employment data from the common carrier railways operating in Canada. Its results are published as data tables, including the railway industry inventory of equipment in service by mainline companies (table 23-10-0058-01, reference years 1986 to 2024), the equivalent inventory for regional railways, and balance sheets of mainline and regional companies, alongside a rail data visualisation hub. Coverage is national. The survey feeds the Canadian System of National Accounts and is used by Transport Canada and other departments to monitor the industry; it is run as part of the Integrated Business Statistics Program. The tables are free to view and available to download as CSV (as displayed, for database loading or as the entire table) and SDMX, each with a DOI and cube metadata, and the latest data release was 28 April 2026. Caveats: data are aggregated by company group and year, not by line or asset, so they describe fleets and finances, not network geometry. The equipment inventories and operating statistics support capacity planning and economic analysis of Canadian rail freight and are useful reference values for rail network models. They complement the National Railway Network (NRWN), which gives the track geometry.
